purpose: Training Ground HTML mockup art requested from GPT at the user's instruction: lobby/result key art and 25 enemy/boss portraits for the enemy list box.
surface: codex exec (codex-cli 0.155.0) built-in image_gen via the installed imagegen skill, one request per asset, four parallel runs
modelEvidence: Codex reported no model name for any image (verifiedModel null).
runtimeUse: Training ground UI (Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Art/TrainingGround, sized by TrainingGroundArtImporter and ResourceTextureBudget) and the HTML mockup

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque wide background illustration, 1536x1024 PNG, for the Training Ground lobby and training result screens of HELLSCRIPT, a dark gothic fantasy action RPG. Rendering: hand-painted realistic dark gothic fantasy environment with the same painterly realism, palette and low-key lighting as the attached reference images (style only; do not copy their scenery). Subject: a sanctuary training yard at night enclosed by ruined gothic walls. In the middle, a circular flagstone sparring arena with a faint engraved aged-brass ring inlaid in the floor. Three battered straw-and-wood training dummies bound with iron bands and chains stand inside the ring: one at the centre, two slightly behind to the left and right. A wooden weapon rack with old swords, a spear and a round shield stands to one side; two iron braziers with warm ember fire stand left and right. Pointed arches, broken pillars and torn dark banners behind, thin ground mist, clouded moonlit sky. Composition (important: the game crops this image to a tall portrait panel about 9:16 around the horizontal centre, to a square, and to a wide banner): keep the central dummy and the ring inside the middle 40% of the width; the lower third (floor) stays dark and low in detail so light text can be overlaid there; the top 15% is dark sky and arches. Palette: charcoal olive (#161813, #24271d), aged brass (#c8ac77), warm ember accents (#ff8a3a), warm ivory candle highlights (#ded3bc); no saturated blue, purple or green. Strict exclusions: no people, no monsters, no text, letters, numbers, runes or glyphs that look like writing, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no border, no frame. Generate one image only. All banners must be plain unmarked dark cloth: absolutely no emblems, sigils, symbols, lines or insignia on fabric. No gargoyle figures. The entire brass floor ring must fit inside the central 40 percent of image width.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one opaque square PNG, exactly 1024x1024, for a game UI monster portrait in HELLSCRIPT, a dark gothic fantasy action RPG.
The two attached reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: use their painterly realism, fine material detail, low-key lighting and restrained palette. Never copy their subjects, faces, clothing or scenery.
Subject: the Bloated Pilgrim, one huge, heavy, round-bodied undead penitent pilgrim with a very wide silhouette. Wrapped in layered, patched grey-brown pilgrim robes that strain around its bulk; a wide-brimmed pilgrim hat casts its face in shadow. A thick rope belt carries small plain wooden relics and a pilgrim's gourd. Heavy hands have intact pale greyish skin. Dull sickly-green eyes glow faintly beneath the hat brim. Keep a small clear margin around all important features: nothing important touches the edges because the UI crops a rounded square.
Background: plain dark smoky charcoal olive (#0f120e to #1c2018), soft vignette and faint mist. No scenery, floor, separate props or other creatures. The belt accessories specified above are the only accessories.
Lighting: key light from upper left and subtle sickly-green rim light; overall low values, faint sickly-green eye glow as the sole emissive accent.
Strict exclusions: no text, letters, numbers, runes, writing-like glyphs, logos, watermarks, UI, drawn border, drawn frame, ring vignette or second creature. Wooden relics are plain and unmarked. Opaque PNG without transparency.
